en: A black and white photograph of a monument in a park setting, surrounded by trees and enclosed by a metal fence. The monument is a statue of a man standing on a plinth, holding a wreath above his head and standing atop a globe. There is a medallion portrait on the pedestal and visible text. A man in period clothing stands in front of the fence, adding a historical context to the scene.
